one_line: Botryllus histocompatibility factor (BHF), a Fester-family allorecognition protein.
summary: Its best match is the allorecognition reference AGS14996.1, a histocompatibility factor, at 100% identity over all 252 residues, so this is a full-length match to a known BHF. That supports a role in the colony's allorecognition system, which decides whether neighbouring colonies fuse or reject each other. No Pfam, InterPro or UniFIRE domain or family call exists, and no Swiss-Prot match was found, so the family assignment rests on the allorecognition reference alone. The FANTASIA cell-junction GO terms come from a single nearest embedding with no alignment and are only a weak hint. The exact molecular mechanism and cellular location are not shown by the evidence here.
confidence_reason: A full-length 100% identity match to a reference histocompatibility factor supports the family and allorecognition role, though the specific mechanism is not shown.
